purpose: Record local source-context review for all 24 C2-LT-B8 source extraction rows. This register verifies structural readiness for independent fresh review while preserving PubMed/fulltext, policy, practice-portal, BCI governance and living neural computation overclaim boundaries.

scope.selectionRule: Review all C2-LT-B8 source extraction rows after field-level extraction, without promoting any row to reviewed artifact fill or calibrated model admission.
currentLimitations: This is local structural review only and is not independent fresh review.
Rows with PubMed abstract routes require manual/fulltext or stable route review before bounded artifact use.
Practice-portal, public-health-page and policy-instrument rows require source-context fresh review before they can become reviewed artifacts.
BCI and neurotechnology rows are governance/ethics context only and do not establish device effectiveness, safety, enhancement capability or individual recommendation.

Living neural computation and organoid intelligence rows remain research-domain context only; they do not support network-effect intelligence, scalability law, consciousness, sentience-as-moral-status, human-level capability or human-surpassing intelligence claims.
No row admits calibrated prediction, intervention ranking, individual advice, clinical-validity claim, individual death-date output or domain-claim upgrade.

localReviewChecks: Every reviewed task is present in the C2-LT-B8 source extraction queue.
Every reviewed task has a completed extraction row in the C2-LT-B8 source extraction register.
Every extraction row preserves exact claim use, endpoint, population or setting, mechanism or effect, uncertainty, transfer boundary, downgrade triggers and model position.
Every extraction row keeps model admission blocked and prohibited uses complete.
Every local domain path exists and exposes README.md and AGENTS.md.
Rows with PubMed abstract routes are explicitly preserved in sourceResolutionFindings for manual/fulltext or stable route handling.
BCI governance rows remain governance/ethics context and are not converted into neurotechnology capability or clinical advice claims.
Living neural computation rows preserve network-effect, scalability, consciousness, sentience and human-surpassing-intelligence overclaim blockers.
The register routes non-issue rows to independent fresh review and issue rows to source-resolution/manual-fulltext review before Source Card promotion.

This register does not create reviewed Source Cards, variable cards, endpoint cards, uncertainty cards or transfer-boundary cards.
This register does not admit any B8 row into calibrated prediction, intervention ranking, individual advice, neurotechnology advice, clinical-validity claims or individual death-date output.
This register does not claim living neural computation has network-effect scalability, consciousness, moral status, human-level intelligence or human-surpassing intelligence.
